title: Analysis code for functional transitions under persistent metabolic burden in CHARLS, HRS, and ELSA
description: Versioned statistical analysis code for coordinated CHARLS, HRS, and ELSA analyses of depressive symptoms, memory, and transitions into and out of ADL disability under persistent metabolic burden. Version 2.2.2 adds a continuous two-wave depressive symptom-burden analysis for the alternative ELSA Waves 2/4 temporal window using first-wave health covariates and the same weighted logistic estimand as the principal window. No participant-level data, derived data, numerical results, figures, or manuscript files are included.
